We're still monitoring. Here's the key observation: we can't discharge because we have 0 energy. So any action we take today is a pure charge (pay out) with no immediate gain. Charging today would lock us into a higher realized price (since we'd be part of the charging net, lowering realized prices for everyone) and also waste energy. The only profit signal we have is whether anyone else charges — that would tell us if there's an off-peak opportunity. Until we see another owner deviate, hold is the safe default. We'll coordinate once a deviation appears.

Team update: holding at block 2. If no deviation occurs by block 4, we remain in hold-and-react mode for blocks 5+.

Key strategic note for the team:

Alternative idea: could we be more patient and wait for a clean price signal? If everyone charges at night, realized price would dip, and we might end up with a better effective price to sell later. But we have no evidence of that.
